title: Adventure-Charters, LLC
specs: Sailing aboard a classic American-made Hinckley Bermuda 40 sailboat

blurb: Guests sail aboard a classic American-made Hinckley Bermuda 40 sailboat. The experience typically lasts about three hours and includes ice, water, sodas, and set-ups provided by the captain. Guests may bring their own snacks and beverages and can participate in steering and sail handling under supervision.
extraNote: Most guests leave a tip at their discretion for the first mate · Slip E-9 in Biloxi Small Craft Harbor, just east of the Hard Rock and Beau Rivage Casinos.

quotes.author: Lynn Saint
quotes.text: If you are visiting Biloxi PLEASE contact Captain Jay and Ms. Patti, they were the most accommodating and welcoming host. We called on Wednesday and were able to go out sailing on Thursday. They were so knowledgeable and experienced and even though it was our first time sailing we were 100% at ease. Our 12 yr old son Hudson was able to steer the boat for most of the trip, and help with the sails all while being taught facts about sailing. We saw more dolphins on this trip than last year on the dolphin tour. Thank you again Captain Jay for allowing us this experience!!

quotes.author: Michael Gielow
quotes.text: Captain Jay and FM Patty (Jane) were fantastic. Very informative and responsive from first contact all the way to embarkation. Jay is a wealth of sailing knowledge and is a lot of fun to talk to. I’m not sure who had more fun, Jay or our son (4th year sailing lessons student) who took the helm early and was all smiles. We highly recommend and will look them up next time in Biloxi.

quotes.author: Rhonda Sutherland
quotes.text: I was very excited to take my nieces on their first sailing adventure and this did not disappoint! Captains Patti and Patrick are super knowledgeable and engaging. They even gave my nieces some supervised time at the helm. Now one of them wants to be a captain in addition to a supermodel! Would highly recommend them. We’ll be back!

quotes.author: Shawn Taylor
quotes.text: Went on sunset cruise with wife and was a very peaceful ride. Very friendly crew of husband and wife crew. Would recommend trying them out. They let us drive and get pictures and then laid on the front and enjoyed each other's company

quotes.author: Billie Walters
quotes.text: Our group of Friends sailed with Jay & Patty last weekend for my Husband's Birthday. They are so very Nice and Knowledgeable! We all enjoyed the trip and will return soon. Thank You!

quotes.author: Megan Mcnichol
quotes.text: We had a sunset sail ride! It was amazing and very relaxing! Captain Jay and David were awesome! The trip was so much fun all of us want to come back again! Thank you Captain Jay!
